== Biography ==
Margaret was born about 1846. Margaret was the child of [[Glasgow-466|John Glasgow]] and [[Blackwood-456|Elizabeth Blackwood]].  

Margaret was listed in the 1850 Census. <ref>["United States Census, 1850," database with images, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M44D-H3C : 9 November 2014), Margaret Glasgow in household of John Glasgow, West Deer, Allegheny, Pennsylvania, United States; citing family 64, NARA microfilm publication M432 (Washington, D.C.: National Archives and Records Administration, n.d.).]</ref>

Margaret passed away about 1926.<ref>A source for this information is needed.</ref>
